0022600193.text: The Warriors (6-3, riding a six-game win streak) host the Orlando Magic (2-6, on a three-game losing streak) in Golden State's 10th game of the season, with the Warriors 2nd in the Pacific and 8th in the West while Orlando is 12th in the East. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while Orlando is missing Desmond Bane (illness), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Warriors winning the most recent meeting 120-97 in San Francisco on December 22, 2025.
